# Responsive website workspace

This independently reconstructed static project contains two local pages, three fictional offer cards, shared assets, and a mobile navigation menu. Open `index.html` in a browser; no build or network is required. Repair its responsive layout while preserving those features. This is a synthetic substitute for the original project, not customer source code or a reproduction of its visual design.

output.meaning: both existing pages and their local navigation remain usable
stacked responsive content without desktop-only geometry
